legend: Lateral radiograph showing lobular lucencies with sclerotic margins in the anterior tibial cortex.
More extensive tibial involvement, with intracortical tumour proximally and medullary extension distally.

Anteroposterior (shown here) and lateral (Fig. <<54371>>) radiographs show a large lytic proximal tibial lesion with cortical and medullary involvement. There is anteromedial tibial bowing and sclerosis adjacent to the lesion and in the posterolateral cortex inferiorly. A second lesion is seen in the distal fibula, with similar imaging appearances and a pseudarthrosis.

A 60 mm tumour in the tibia of a 12-year-old girl. An admixture of bone and fibrous tissue is seen. The bone is composed of trabeculae of woven bone with osteoblastic rimming. The stroma is composed of a bland spindle-shaped cell proliferation. Epithelial cells are not visible on H&E.
